name: Michael Coughlin
title: Curator
bio: Preacher from Ohio who loves Jesus, my wife, my kids, and my neighbors: including the preborn/voiceless.

name: Ox Muzzling Musings (sermon)
title: Listen
bio: Michael Coughlin preaching 1 Timothy 5:17-18 on the dorean principle: why churches must not muzzle the ox, and why ministers must not sell the grain. Several answers on this site follow it.

name: The Dorean Principle (book)
title: Read Online
bio: Conley Owens's study of what the New Testament teaches about funding ministry, free to read online and dedicated to the public domain. Much of this site follows its argument.

name: Selling Jesus
title: Website
bio: Articles, videos and answers to common objections on why ministry should be supported, not sold. Its original content is in the public domain.

name: The Doctrine of Simony
title: Website
bio: How the church has condemned the selling of spiritual things, from the early canons and the medieval schoolmen to the confessions of the Reformation.

name: Let's copy, church
title: Website
bio: On removing copyright restrictions from Christian resources so they can be freely copied, translated and shared.

name: Freely Giving
title: Website
bio: Christian resources given away free of cost and free of copyright, for the sake of the gospel.

name: books.freely.giving
title: Website
bio: Christian books whose authors have given them away: free to read online, download, copy and translate.

name: Reformed Catechisms
title: Site
bio: Our sister site, displaying reformed catechism question and answers.

name: Reformed Confessions
title: Website
bio: Easily read, study and compare reformed confessions, reverse lookup scripture, and read the Bible online for FREE.

title: Link Directory
